additional_info.body:
Dear Mr.Orel,
Hope you are doing well,
We have inspected the charger via SSH and identified anomalies related to the signal strength for the router 1&2. The signal strength varies between fair to poor and, at sometimes shows no signal.
Based on this observation, a decision needs to be made regarding the possible measures to stabilize the connectivity or network stability.
Recommendation-:
Check the charger’s router or SIM router settings and ensure it is configured to use the strongest available cellular frequency or network provider (e.g., 4G or LTE instead of 3G).
If stability remains an issue, consider switching from a SIM-based connection to a wired network
